create_TensorDataset: create a TensorDataset wrapping multiple tensors with matching first dimensions
build_ConcatDataset: build a ConcatDataset by concatenating multiple map-style datasets into one
create_StackDataset: create a StackDataset that stacks multiple datasets as tuple or dict outputs
test_Subset: test the Subset class to index a dataset at specified indices
refactor_random_split: refactor random_split to divide a dataset into non-overlapping subsets by lengths or fractions
